infographics.title: Needs vs Wants: The Student Matrix
infographics.caption: A clear visual comparison between essential student requirements for academic survival and optional lifestyle wants.
infographics.alt: Infographic showing side-by-side comparison of student needs like groceries, rent, transit, books versus wants like gaming, takeout, designer fashion, and streaming

infographics.title: The 50-30-20 Student Split Flow
infographics.caption: How to funnel every monthly allowance or internship paycheck into 50% Needs, 30% Wants, and 20% Future Savings.
infographics.alt: Circular flow diagram showing total monthly income splitting into 50 percent for essentials, 30 percent for lifestyle, and 20 percent for savings and debt buffer

infographics.title: The 4-Step Monthly Student Budget Cycle
infographics.caption: A cyclical journey every student can repeat each month: 1. Earn/Receive, 2. Plan Allocations, 3. Track Daily, 4. Review & Optimize.
infographics.alt: 4-phase circular flowchart explaining the recurring student monthly budgeting cycle from income to planning, tracking, and month-end review

infographics.title: 3 Student Friendly Savings Challenges
infographics.caption: Gamified ways to save money without feeling deprived: The 52-Week Challenge, the $5 Spare Change Challenge, and the Zero-Spend Weekend.
infographics.alt: Visual chart comparing 3 student savings challenges with achievable monthly milestones and reward incentives
